components.description: The one primary action of a view: Download, Next, Finish, Change keys, Re-check.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every action that is not the view's primary one, and every row action that is not the live row's.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFDF6; color: #2C2721; border: 1px solid #C9BCA3; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F1EADA; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { color: #665E52; border-color: #E7DECB; cursor: default; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Quant and sort chips. The selected chip is crayon ink on a sheet, never a filled primary button.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #FFFDF6; color: #2C2721; border: 1px solid #C9BCA3; border-radius: 10px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip.is-selected { color: #C0442F; border-color: #C0442F; }

components.name: Sheet
components.description: The grouped surface: capability plate, model row, a settings card. The live sheet is the same fill behind a 1.5px crayon frame.
components.css: .ds-sheet { background: #FFFDF6; color: #2C2721; border: 1px solid #E7DECB; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; } .ds-sheet.is-live { border: 1.5px solid #C0442F; }

components.name: Inset
components.description: A grouped block inside a sheet: a hairline and 12px padding, no fill. Never a card in a card.

components.name: Field
components.description: Search field and pick lists. The frame turns crayon while focused.

narrative.overview:
Littera's windows explain themselves the way a good reading book does: one plain sentence at a time, generous margins, one crayon colour marking where you are. Settings opens on a sentence that answers the only question a person has when they open it — can I dictate right now? — then states four machine facts as label/value rows and gets out of the way.

The use scene fixes the light: a desk, a bright room or a dim one, the window open for the fifteen seconds it takes to change one setting. Paper, not steel; ink, not silk-screen. Nothing is condensed, stamped or upper-case: the world it replaced read as lab equipment, and this one reads as a page.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, white sheets, one crayon accent.
One typeface (Atkinson Hyperlegible) in two weights; hierarchy by weight and space, never a fourth size.
Sentence case everywhere; monospace only for real data.
Every state says its word; colour is the second signal.
Flat and softly rounded: 10px controls, 14px sheets; the only shadow is an open pick-list menu.
rules: The One Crayon Rule: one saturated accent, used only for the live thing and the primary action.
The Word-Before-Colour Rule: name a state in words, then tone it.
The Sentence-Case Rule: nothing is set in upper case.
The No-Card-Inside-A-Card Rule: a block inside a sheet is an inset, not a card.
The Weight-Not-Size Rule: new emphasis is weight or space, never a bigger step.
dos: Open every surface with one plain sentence that answers why it is open.
State a state in words and then tone it.
Keep one primary action per view.
Leave more space above a heading than below it.
donts: Don't use upper case or a condensed face.
Don't add a second accent colour, a gradient, a glow or a shadow on a sheet.
Don't nest a card inside a card.
Don't hide an action's word behind a tooltip.
Don't reach for a bigger type size to add emphasis.
